review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-03 delegated author, part A2); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-03 part A2, fix round 2 of Cloud #121 (reviewed at 99e39bc). The center changes: the passkeys, sessions and devices pages say that they need their script (a noscript paragraph and the default-visible line that the script removes), the session cookie's Max-Age bound is six digits (the longest session a policy admits is seven days, 604800 seconds), and the package comment of the pages names the callers of the in-process API handlers. The Worker's generated center tables follow with that one bound. The browser acceptance package and its operator tooling (one request budget for the whole browser with the redirect hops charged to it, the observed request count in the report, the cleanup of what a failed run leaves, the refusal of a saved credential of another center) and the test changes are not part of the image or the bundle. No Go module, base image, toolchain, legal file or migration changes. It supersedes the A2 admission at cloud-release-r71; the center templates, one center constant and the generated Worker tables changed after r71.
